summary: First testing pass for Suntek Designs redesign. Backend (8/8 pytest tests) and frontend (all requested interactions) fully green. Contact form, honeypot, Resend email (email_sent=true), before/after slider, testimonials next, services hover reveal, and all sections verified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: honeypot POST returns {success:true} but no 'id' or 'email_sent' — frontend treats it as success and shows the thank-you block (intended behavior, but worth documenting).

server.py: Enquiry.created_at stored as ISO string but exposed as string in GET response (Pydantic model expects datetime). Currently harmless because GET returns raw docs without validation. Consider normalising for API contract stability.

ContactForm.jsx: The email input's data-testid='input-email' and phone's data-testid='input-phone' are attached to the <input>, but the Field wrapper's testid prop is unused (label wrapper testid not applied). Not blocking.
server.py has @app.on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI (use lifespan). Minor.
test_credentials: None required — public site + public /api/enquiries endpoint.
seed_data_creation: Created 4 TEST_-prefixed enquiries in MongoDB via pytest + 1 via UI submission (all visible via GET /api/enquiries). Emails were dispatched via Emergent Resend proxy (HTTP 202 Accepted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints tested via /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — reusable regression suite. Frontend URL: https://design-journey-75.preview.emergentagent.com. Data-testids in kebab-case: hero-cta-explore, hero-cta-consultation, site-nav, {name}-section (introduction, projects, services, why, process, before-after, testimonials, cinematic-cta), contact-section, site-footer. Contact form testids: input-full-name, input-email, input-phone, select-property-type, select-project-type, select-budget, input-start-date, input-message, submit-enquiry, contact-success-message, field-error. Before/After: before-after-slider + before-after-handle (drag with mouse events changes clip-path). Testimonials: testimonial-prev / testimonial-next. Services desktop hover on service-item-{id} sets h3 to text-bronze and swaps preview image. On mobile the section switches to accordion with service-mobile-trigger-{id}.
verified_flows: POST /api/enquiries valid -> 200 success=true, id present, email_sent=true (Resend 202)
POST /api/enquiries with website honeypot -> 200 success but not persisted (count unchanged)
Hero renders 'Spaces Designed' + both CTAs, scroll indicator visible
site-nav renders with Projects/Services/About/Process/Contact + Book a Consultation
Testimonial next click cycles content (verified text change)
Services desktop hover on service-item-carpentry -> h3 gets text-bronze + right image src changes
Contact form empty submit -> 3 field-error messages for name/email/phone
Contact form valid submit -> 200 API response, success block appears, sonner toast fires, enquiry persisted in Mongo
